title: Hom fibers in the filtered arrow colimit
statement: For a small category J and F : J → Cat [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], form the object colimit O and arrow colimit A [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Descend the stage source and target functions to maps A → O. Define Hom(X,Y) as the subtype of A with source X and target Y, and send a stage morphism to its arrow class with its endpoint certificates.
